result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.random_walk_with_restart()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Random walk with restart (RWR) from a set of seed nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L18003-L18092){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.random_walk_with_restart( seeds, restart_prob=0.15, max_iter=100, tol=1e-06, attr_name=None, return_dict=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} At each step the walker either follows a random outgoing edge (with probability `1 - restart_prob`) or teleports back to one of the seed nodes (with probability `restart_prob`). Returns the steady-state visitation probability for every node. RWR is mathematically equivalent to Personalized PageRank. This method provides a more intuitive interface for the common genomics use case of propagating scores from GWAS hits through a protein-protein interaction network. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [seeds]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[int, float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Dictionary mapping seed node IDs to initial scores (e.g., ``-log10(p_value)`` from GWAS). Values are normalized internally. [restart_prob]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.15]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Probability of teleporting back to a seed node at each step. Higher values keep the walk closer to the seeds. Typical range: `0.1`-`0.3`. [max_iter]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[100]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Maximum number of iterations. [tol]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1e-06]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Convergence tolerance. [attr_name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Column name for the node DataFrame. Defaults to `"rwr"`. [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, returns the score dictionary. Otherwise stores and returns self. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Union[dict[int, float], Graph]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Steady-state visitation probabilities for all nodes. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#f325cfc5 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="BRCA1") .add_node(label="TP53") .add_node(label="ATM") .add_node(label="CHEK2") .add_edge("BRCA1", "TP53") .add_edge("TP53", "ATM") .add_edge("ATM", "CHEK2") .add_edge("BRCA1", "CHEK2") ) seed_id = graph.get_id_from_label("BRCA1") scores = graph.random_walk_with_restart( seeds={seed_id: 1.0}, restart_prob=0.15, return_dict=True, ) {graph.get_label_from_id(nid): round(s, 4) for nid, s in scores.items()} ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {'ATM': 0.1953, 'BRCA1': 0.3453, 'CHEK2': 0.2297, 'TP53': 0.2297} ``` ::: :::
